method: Separate temporary build under target/gsusb-profile-src; aggregate nanosecond timers around each blocking USB write, echo-slot acquisition, and complete send_frame call; logged every 5000 sends. No transmit scheduling changes.
duration: 10 seconds submission per direction plus drain
interpretation: Serialized USB OUT completion is the observed bottleneck. USB call time includes Windows/backend/controller scheduling and device-side readiness; these were not separately measured. Echo-slot wait and IPC/driver scheduling are much smaller.
